results: Two Bezout taps construct G=gcd(s_n,A^d-B^d)>0, retaining full birth depth and removing ordinary exponent lifting.
All finite stride-d integer taps generate precisely G Z; G is the smallest positive output.
For primitive stride d=2n, G=s_n, so taps cannot lower height; half-order shifts lose odd birth contact.
rth vanishing differences amplify birth depth by r and auxiliary height by r, leaving the depth/height bound unchanged.
General contact-preserving short taps require P|T(A)-T(B); a nonzero difference pays at least P(A-B), while equal evaluations reconstruct a multiple of s_n or zero.
Physical convolution is exactly reverse support relabeling; rational denominators subtract their p-adic valuation.
